name: alibaba/wan/3.0/pro/reference-to-video
description: Wan 3.0 Pro by Alibaba generates up to 30-second videos with native audio from reference images, videos, and audio, keeping subjects, motion, and voice consistent with the references, upscaled to 1080p, 2K, or 4K.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed (0-2147483647) for reproducible results. Omit for a random seed; the same seed may still produce slightly different results.

audios.title: Audios
audios.description: Up to 5 reference audio URLs (WAV or MP3; 1-15s each, 15s total, under 15MB each). Cannot be combined with `image` or `end_image`.

images.title: Images
images.description: Up to 10 reference image URLs (JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WebP; up to 20MB each, 240-8000px per side). Refer to them in the prompt as Image 1, Image 2, and so on. Provide at least one of `images`, `videos`, or `audios`.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt directing how the reference media is used. Reference media can be addressed positionally, e.g. 'the subject in Image 1 walks past Video 1'.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Up to 5 reference video URLs (MP4 or MOV; 1-15s each, 15s total, under 100MB each). Cannot be combined with `image` or `end_image`.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Output duration in seconds (2-30), or `auto` to let the model pick a length from the prompt and inputs. `auto` is pre-authorized at 30 seconds and billed on the actual output length.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Output resolution tier after FlashVSR super-resolution.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Omit to let the model choose from the prompt and reference inputs.

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Generate a synchronized audio track. Pricing is the same either way.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

input.prompt: Using the lip gloss product in Image 1, generate a model swatch video, 5 seconds, horizontal screen, highlighting the lip color effect

readme:
# Wan 3.0 Pro Reference to Video

Generate a new shot that reuses what you already have: faces and products from images, motion and framing from clips, voices and music from audio. The prompt decides how the references come together. Pro runs the same Wan 3.0 model, then upscales the result with FlashVSR, so output comes back at 1080p, 2K, or 4K. For 480p or 720p use the non-Pro endpoints.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 5,000 characters. |
| `images` | image URL[] (≤10) | — | Referenced as Image 1, Image 2, … |
| `videos` | video URL[] (≤5) | — | MP4/MOV, 1–15s each, 15s total, ≤100MB. Referenced as Video 1, … |
| `audios` | audio URL[] (≤5) | — | WAV/MP3, 1–15s each, 15s total, ≤15MB. Referenced as Audio 1, … |
| `duration` | 2–30 or `auto` | 5 | `auto` lets the model pick the length. |
| `resolution` | `1080p` / `2k` / `4k` | `1080p` | Output tier after FlashVSR super-resolution; sets the per-second rate. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `adaptive` / `16:9` / `4:3` / `1:1` / `3:4` / `9:16` | `adaptive` | `adaptive` follows the prompt and inputs. |
| `generate_audio` | boolean | true | Native dialogue, music, and effects. Same price on or off. |
| `seed` | integer 0–2147483647 | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

Send at least one of `images`, `videos`, or `audios`; any combination works.

## Billing

You pay per second of output plus, when you send reference `videos`, their total length (rounded up, counted up to 15s): $0.18 at 1080p, $0.20 at 2K, $0.23 at 4K. Input images and audio are not metered. If the reference video length cannot be read, 15s is assumed.

| Request | Billed | 1080p | 2K | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5s output (default) | 5s | $0.90 | $1.00 | $1.15 |
| 10s output | 10s | $1.80 | $2.00 | $2.30 |
| 30s output | 30s | $5.40 | $6.00 | $6.90 |
| 5s output + 8s reference video | 13s | $2.34 | $2.60 | $2.99 |
| 5s output + 15s reference videos | 20s | $3.60 | $4.00 | $4.60 |

With `duration: "auto"` the run is pre-authorized at 30 seconds, then settled on the length that was actually generated. Failed runs are not charged. Output files are copied to SandBase storage and the returned URL stays valid for 7 days; download anything you need to keep.

## Prompting

- Give every reference a job: “Image 1 is the cyclist, Video 1 provides the camera move.”
- Several images of the same subject from different angles hold identity better than one.
- Keep reference audio short and focused on the voice or sound you want carried over.

> Image 1 is the cyclist; Video 1 supplies the camera movement. She rides through a rainy city at night in the same red jacket, with quiet traffic in the background.

## Limits

- Up to 10 images, 5 videos (15s total), and 5 audio clips (15s total).
- Reference video length plus output length must stay within 30 seconds.
- First/last frames are not accepted here; use image-to-video.

## Also on SandBase

Other Wan 3.0 Pro endpoints: `alibaba/wan/3.0/pro/video` (all modes in one schema), `alibaba/wan/3.0/pro/text-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/3.0/pro/image-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/3.0/pro/video-edit`, `alibaba/wan/3.0/pro/video-extend`.
